_file_role: Tunable parameters ONLY. Secrets (token, chat_id) live in token.env.

market_hours._comment: Rahul turns Telegram notifications ON at 09:00 and OFF at 15:30. DRISHTI uses this to decide whether to send loud vs silent messages.

notification_mode._comment: inside_market=normal (rings immediately). outside_market=silent (delivered but no ring; Rahul sees it when he checks manually). Implemented via Telegram disable_notification=True.

token_persistence._comment: DRISHTI saves the token to disk after every hot_reload so VPS restarts reconnect without manual re-entry.

quiet_hours._comment: Outbound reminder messages are suppressed outside this window. Bot still ACCEPTS incoming messages 24/7.

token_reminders._comment: Scheduled reminder type. Fires only on NSE weekdays. Suppressed when token is still valid (< 24h old).

health_check._comment: Proactive health reports sent during trading window.

nifty_ltp_feed._comment: REST background feed — operator tunes via DRISHTI LTP Feed Setup. Persisted copy in data/nifty_ltp_feed_config.json.
nifty_ltp_feed._feed_modes: websocket = in-process Dhan MarketFeed v2 (default). rest = DRISHTI polls POST /marketfeed/ltp. Auth remains JWT/access token. Failover may switch transport for the session without rewriting this default.
nifty_ltp_feed._auto_failover_comment: Runtime WS→REST failover when WebSocket crashes (stale OR repeated errors). Does NOT change nifty_ltp_feed_config.json — operator switches mode manually in LTP Feed Setup. REST stays for session; next trading day retries WebSocket.

retry._comment: Retry behaviour for health check API calls (broker / LTP fetch).

gift_nifty._comment: GIFT Nifty symbol candidates for Dhan. Tried in order — first success wins. Falls back to source if all fail.

alerts._comment: Immediate health alert settings. No quiet hours, no suppression.

uat_market_replay._session_tail_hours_comment: Keep only last N hours of cash session (ends 15:30 IST). 3 → 12:30–15:30.
uat_market_replay._max_source_days_comment: Concatenate up to N newest day logs after tail filter.
uat_market_replay._replay_speed_options: realtime | fast | ultra — fast = 3x (1s stored = ~333ms replay)
